Settings.Name: Turn Dark and Gate on / off
Settings.Description: Switches the whole mod off and back on. Off gives you vanilla BG3: the normal camera, cursor, HUD and click-to-move, and turn-based fights. Use it if a spot can't be done in first person or in real time. Your PC remembers the choice.
Settings.Tooltip: The same as typing !dag_play off / !dag_play in the Script Extender console. In co-op, fights stay real time while any player still has the mod on.

Settings.Name: Mouse-look sensitivity
Settings.Description: How fast the first-person camera turns with your mouse. 1.0 is BG3's own speed; lower is slower, higher is faster.
Settings.Tooltip: Takes effect right away. Only the first-person camera changes; the cursor in menus moves as always.
